_help: Applied in order — full sentences first, then paragraphs, then the hero word pills, then contact + brand renames. Rules with an empty "to" are skipped. Preview: npm run rebrand:dry  |  Apply: npm run rebrand

replacements.from: where the problems are hardest and the standards are least forgiving: the factory floor. Mind is collecting video data at industrial scale, capturing live, high-variability work as it happens on the line, starting with automotive manufacturing.
replacements.to: is founded and managed by young, dynamic and seasoned professionals with creative minds, passion for excellence and a strong vision for success. The promoters are Masters in Engineering and Management from premier schools.

replacements.from: Our foundation models learn spatial reasoning, object dynamics, and tool manipulation across real production hours, building a scalable intelligence layer that generalizes to new tasks and environments. The hardware we design works alongside the people and systems already in place.
replacements.to: Having decades of industry experience, spanning across various industries in Europe, US and Asia-Pacific, we provide expert solutions tailored to meet customer requirements.

replacements.from: as our first manufacturing partner, we're building a rich dataset inside a live production facility and training on active vehicle lines. Our data pipeline is centered on learning from skilled operators as they perform highly dexterous tasks, distilling the actions, tools, context, and decisions that make each cycle successful.
replacements.to: provides expert technology solutions aiming to improve engineering productivity and reduce product cost.

replacements.from: Mind’s live dataset gives our models a deep understanding of real-world physics, variance, and material behavior. By mastering diverse automotive tasks first, we’re building capabilities that transfer across all of industrial manufacturing.
replacements.to: Using data transformation, statistical analysis, and machine learning, we find patterns, make predictions, and turn process data into actionable insight.

replacements.from: At Mind, we believe that being hands on with hardware can solve the hardest problems in AI.
replacements.to: At HIM, we believe that being hands on with hardware can solve the hardest problems in engineering.

replacements.from: Mind offers the agility of a startup with the resources, data, and built-in customer base of an industrial pioneer.
replacements.to: HIM offers the agility of a startup with decades of industry experience across Europe, US and Asia-Pacific.

replacements.from: Locating, grasping, and placing objects that vary in angle, occlusion, and orientation, with high precision.
replacements.to: Design and manufacturing intelligence: product improvements that reduce part count and cost, engineering problem solving through analysis, optimum part handling solutions, and automation with PLCs, sensors and actuators.

replacements.from: Making a real-time call on visually similar items and routing each one correctly, under line speed pressure.
replacements.to: Robotics and Internet of Things: industrial, commercial and defence / nuclear applications, sensor selection with circuitry for data capture, and data analytics from transformation to machine-learning insight.

replacements.from: Joining parts that don't always align, modulating force and sequence to seat them correctly, and recovering when they don't.
replacements.to: Manufacturing and assembly risk prediction, engineering de-skilling to reduce human error, and anomaly detection with actionable early warning of failures.
